The insurance was valid for one month, as stated. The staff member I called asked if I needed a new filling, and they said they would have to come back to you. It was a reasonable idea, and the doctor would reassess it, potentially costing me another 1,000 baht. I've used their services many times, including my girlfriend, but this time I wasn't impressed. I paid a lot, but I'm happy to see them do better. They're responsible for the fact that it fell off so quickly.

I used to think of this place for anything related to my teeth, but now I won't go back and will tell them again.
